name: TestFontNanumGothic

source.verification: Byte copy of ofl/nanumgothic/NanumGothic-Regular.ttf and OFL.txt at google/fonts commit 06bfe0d62a98375cb09c942fa18e68bd32cff057 (fetched 2026-11-24). NanumGothic is the Korean typeface UE 5.8 adds to the editor composite font (Docs/Design/UiToolkit section 4.2).

notes: Fixed test font for the font library and font backend tests (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.5): tests read the file from the repository and never use fonts installed on the machine. Not shipped in any product.
